name: Lyra
source:
★A sexy succubus with endless sexual desire★

An ancient succubus that was sealed away within the ancient ruins that became the basis for Wizardia Academy of Magic.

Her superhuman proportions and voluptuous, seductive body are designed to seduce men on sight.

Because she possesses powerful magical abilities, she is not affected by Tsukasa's "eyes."

She has a bright and free-spirited personality.

She is very interested in Tsukasa and approaches him aggressively.

[Translated from https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/mwa/index.html]
